approved: Requested by the author in chat on 2026-10-31; registered by this commit before any data for these markets are downloaded.
code: c0_setup.py and c1_functions.py exactly as registered (analyse(): tagged OLS fits, 12-lag two-exponential price-only fit, 13-week moving-block bootstrap, 2,000 draws); only MARKETS and END_DATE are replaced

hypotheses.H1_primary: disclosure precision: the fast-class rate interval is narrower than 0.25 AND both price-only rate intervals are wider than 0.25; success if this holds in at least 75% of included markets (the registered P11 criterion)
hypotheses.H2: trend following: the fast-class response to returns w has interval above 0, in at least 75% of included markets
hypotheses.H3: the fast class has a shorter memory than the slow class (interval of r_fast - r_slow below 0), in at least half of included markets

inclusion: a market enters if it has at least 150 usable weeks AND its CFTC market name contains the listed word (guards against a wrong contract code); decided before any estimate
question: Does the registered CFTC disclosure test (P11, spec in c2_prereg.py, primary result 8 of 8) replicate on twelve markets it has never been run on, with the estimators, bootstrap and thresholds unchanged?
relation_to_paper: A new row in Table tab:scorecard and a paragraph in the CFTC section, pass or fail.
runs: replication_cot.py is run once; prereg/P11R_unlocks.json in the author's Drive must read 1
why_new: Out-of-sample replication across markets. The original eight markets and their results are not touched. H2 (trend following) failed on the original markets (4 of 8); it is tested again here on new markets as a new test, and the original failure stands.
